CourseReview.title: Course Review
CourseReview.description: A review left by a user for a specific course.

courseId.description: The ID of the course being reviewed.

userId.description: The ID of the user who left the review.

userName.description: The display name of the user.

userPhoto.description: The URL of the user's profile photo.

rating.description: The rating given by the user, from 1 to 5.

comment.description: The text content of the review.

createdAt.description: The time the review was created.
